name: 14051-videochat-nano12bvl-1gpu
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL-BF16, not substituted. ~24 GB of bf16 safetensors over 7 shards, public and ungated. This is the canonical id; the short `nvidia/Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL-BF16` is an HF redirect.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One card, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, 20% warmup, 60 requests bounded with a 2400 s safety cap, so 48 are measured. streams=1 is pinned and must not be walked upward: a second concurrent clip does not fit on one 80 GB card at mem-fraction-static 0.8.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_video`, one clip per request and no text column -- the message content is a single `video_url` part carrying a `data:video/mp4;base64,...` URI, which the engine's own decoder accepts, so no file server is needed. The clip is 128 frames of 512x512 at 1.0 fps (128 seconds), h264/mp4, `content: gradient`. Eight output tokens are requested with `ignore_eos` and temperature 0. Every request gets a different clip -- the generator varies its RNG stream by row index -- so no request is served out of another request's work.
purpose: A video Q&A assistant reading two-minute clips one at a time, single stream, on one H100.
launch:
# The whole launch command. Anything not written here is a stock default of the pinned commit.

# The canonical checkpoint id; the short `nvidia/Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL-BF16` is an HF redirect.
model-path: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL-BF16

# Required: the checkpoint ships its own configuration/modeling/image-processing modules.
trust-remote-code: true

mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# A Nemotron-H hybrid needs an explicit recurrent-state pool, separate from the KV cache.
max-mamba-cache-size: 128

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
